images.alt: Раскопанные каменные основания Темпло-Майор в центре Мехико — иллюстрация
images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: wide 16:9 premium travel website hero, photorealistic editorial illustration, restrained realistic travel composition, natural daylight and texture. No text, logos, watermark, collage, frame or inset. Present-day Templo Mayor archaeological site in central Mexico City. Oblique ground-level view over authentic excavated low stepped basalt and reddish volcanic stone foundations, several successive low walls and exposed terraces in a rectangular archaeological pit, simple raised visitor walkway at edge. Modern urban buildings and a restrained partial glimpse of Metropolitan Cathedral in distant background. Clearly archaeological ruins below surrounding street level, no intact towering pyramid, no invented reconstructed twin temples, no fantasy ancient city. Right-side ruins dominant, calm stone area and sky left for title.
